beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: The Bureau wants another payment. I can't keep up.
beats.terra: Inez: The Bureau wants another payment tomorrow. I can't keep up.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: I owe them too. Have you told Okafor?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: He knows. We meet after his shift.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: You're seeing him, then.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Yes. If the Office hears, we'll both lose our jobs.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: Then we keep it between us. Have you eaten today?
beats.terra: Milena: Then we keep it between us.

beats.speaker: Scout
beats.line: Clear her loan. Use Okafor.

learned: Debt: Bureau loan, and she's behind.
Secret: seeing Okafor, the door guard.
opens: Pressure: threaten to expose the affair.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Miss Nikolaou, we paid part of your Bureau loan.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: You paid it? Not so loud. I don't even know you.
beats.terra: Inez: You paid it? I don't even know you.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: No need to worry. We'll bring the rest.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Why would you do that?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: We may ask one small thing later. It won't hurt anyone.
beats.terra: Fixer: We may ask one small thing later.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Thank you, but I can't promise anything.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: You don't have to promise anything today. You've enough on.
beats.terra: Fixer: You don't have to promise anything today.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: All right. Thank you.

learned: Inez took it. Not ready yet.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Miss Nikolaou, we paid the rest of your loan.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: You did bring it. Thank you. What do I do?
beats.terra: Inez: Thank you. What do you want me to do?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: When I telephone, call Okafor over from his door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: You know about us. What happens to him?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Easy, now. Nothing, if it goes right. He never sees us.
beats.terra: Fixer: Nothing, if it goes right. He never sees us.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Why would he leave his post?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Say you have something to tell him, not by telephone.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: All right. I'll do it.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: If I see trouble on the square, I'll warn you.

learned: Loan paid. Inez is with us.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Miss Nikolaou, it's time.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: All right.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: How's your shift, love?
beats.terra: Inez: How's your shift, love.

beats.speaker: Okafor
beats.line: Quiet. I've the door till shift's end. Good to hear you.
beats.terra: Okafor: Quiet. I've got the door till shift's end.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I have something to tell you, not by telephone.

beats.speaker: Okafor
beats.line: For you, I'll come over.
beats.terra: Okafor: It's you. I'll come over.

beats.speaker: Okafor
beats.line: I'm glad of the excuse. I'm on my way.
beats.terra: Okafor: I'm glad I'll see you.

opens: Camera blind? Then enter the Office.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Miss Nikolaou, the Office could learn about you and Okafor.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who told you? Please. We'd both lose our jobs.
beats.terra: Inez: Please. We would both lose our jobs.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: We know. I'm sorry. Get your breath.
beats.terra: Fixer: We know. I am sorry.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: What do you want?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: When I telephone, call Okafor away from his door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: All right. I hate this.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: I know. We'll be quick. See to your tables.
beats.terra: Fixer: I know.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Leave him out of it as much as you can.

learned: Threatened, she agreed; knows Fixer's face.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Miss Nikolaou, it's time. Not a word of us to him.
beats.terra: Fixer: Miss Nikolaou, it's time.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: All right.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: It's me, love. I have something to tell you. Not by telephone.
beats.terra: Inez: Okafor, I have something to tell you. Not by telephone.

beats.speaker: Okafor
beats.line: You sound tired. I have the door.
beats.terra: Okafor: I have the door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Please. I need to tell you in person.

beats.speaker: Okafor
beats.line: All right. I'm coming.

street.speaker: Inez
street.line: Someone knows about us. They looked suspicious.

street.speaker: Okafor
street.line: My door's standing empty. I have to go.

learned: She'll warn him when he arrives.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: You've paid, and it's been a lean month. Spell out the job.
beats.terra: Zhou: It's been a lean month. Spell out the job.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: At the chime, the Councillor gets in.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Drive to the service bay, east yard, round the back.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Wait a couple of minutes, then drive on.
beats.terra: The Fixer: Wait two minutes, then drive on.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: Not home.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not home.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: I'll send off anyone watching the bay.

beats.speaker: Zhou
beats.line: I won't look, and I won't ask who you people are.
beats.terra: Zhou: I won't look at what happens.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: We appreciate that, Zhou. You've had a hard month.
beats.terra: The Fixer: We appreciate that.

learned: Zhou waits a couple of minutes.
